notes.title: Safe-breaker achievement fix
notes.content:
We've fixed the Safe-breaker achievement. 

Apologies to everyone affected by the issue.

notes.title: Italian localization, controller support and Steam Deck support.
notes.content:
Hello everyone! 

This update features improved controller support, Steam Deck support, and Italian localization.

Merry Christmas and a Happy New Year!

notes.title: Dutch and French localizations.
notes.content:
Great news. We've added Dutch and French localizations to the game.

Happy gamimg everyone!

notes.title: Trading cards added!
notes.content:
Great news everyone!

Steam trading cards, emoticons, badges and all that good stuff are finally here. Collect them all.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36085996/3eecfe44b1c5f55d924e1d5d1b2240df16687de3.png[/img]

notes.title: Version 1.1.5
notes.content:
In this minor update, we've slightly improved the video scenes quality. 
It'll take more time for Chinese subtitles to disappear. 

Happy gaming everyone!

notes.title: Chinese localization
notes.content:
Chinese localization has been added to The Wild Case. 

Huge thank you to the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/34815366-%25E7%2588%25B1%25E3%2581%25AE%25E6%25A6%25A8%25E6%25B1%2581%25E5%25B1%258B/]爱の榨汁屋[/url] curator for making this happen!

Happy gaming everyone.

notes.title: Spanish localization
notes.content:
Spanish localization has been added to the game. 

Happy gaming everyone!

notes.title: Save files fix.
notes.content:
This update fixes the date specific save files issue that appeared recently.
It also includes some minor tweaks and fixes.

Happy gaming everyone!

notes.title: Update notes
notes.content:
- Grammar fixes in Russian localization
- Grindstone animation fix
- Moonshiner bucket animation fix
- Ambient sound in forest and mines now can be adjusted in the Options via the Music slider
- Blacksmith door fix
- Ultra-wide display UI and Scenes fix
- Wrench in mines fix - Thank you Dunebuggy

notes.title: 2D first-person point-and-click adventure The Wild Case is out now
notes.content:
2D and yet first-person? Imagine playing a hidden object game but it's a point and click adventure, that's sort of what you get with the new release of The Wild Case.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2021/04/2d-first-person-point-and-click-adventure-the-wild-case-is-out-now

notes.title: It's ALIVE!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36085996/3eecfe44b1c5f55d924e1d5d1b2240df16687de3.png[/img]

Great news everyone! The Wild Case is released!😍

We do hope that you'll enjoy our new game.
Please don't forget to leave your honest reviews!

Happy gaming!

notes.title: The Wild Case demo updated.
notes.content:
Hello everyone. The Wild Case is on its way to get released soon, so we've updated the demo. There might be some bugs still and not everything is final, but it's pretty close to the final look. Do try it and share your feedback on our Discord server or email us! 

Don't forget to wishlist the game if you haven't yet:)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1178230/The_Wild_Case
